hints.title: Digit Reversal Transformation
hints.text: For each integer x in nums, reverse its decimal digits to obtain rev_x.

hints.title: Set Unification
hints.text: Add both the original integer x and its reversed counterpart rev_x into a hash set.

hints.title: Distinct Cardinality
hints.text: The length of the set gives the exact count of unique integers in the augmented array.

hints.title: Distinct Reversed Set Implementation

variables: d: number of digits in max integer
complexity.notes: Each number is converted and reversed in constant digit steps (d <= 7).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Maintaining list duplicates without a hash set requires quadratic deduplication.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Set stores up to 2n unique integer entries.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Inserts original and reversed values into a hash set to return set cardinality.
